EXT.HARTSHORNE_BERTINI.scope: For any algebraically closed field K, natural numbers N,c with c+2<=N, positive assigned degrees d_i and literal homogeneous polynomials P_i in N variables, assume that at every nonzero common zero x the matrix with rows the formal gradients of the P_i at x has rank c. Then there exists a nonzero vector u in K^N such that for every nonzero common zero x also satisfying u dot x=0 there is v in K^N with every gradient(P_i,x) dot v=0 and u dot v != 0. The geometric Jacobian, dimension and tangent interpretation is an explicit source component of this general coordinate Bertini interface. No rank increase, quadric specialization, finite-field rational hyperplane, elimination polynomial, or quantitative bound is asserted.

EXT.PROJECTIVE_JACOBIAN.scope: For any finite homogeneous system in N variables over an algebraically closed field, full rank c of the Jacobian at every nonzero common zero gives a smooth projective closed subscheme locally of dimension N-1-c. Its cone tangent is the common kernel of the formal gradients, its projective tangent is the quotient by the radial line, and a proper regular hyperplane section has nonzero differential on that tangent. The smooth projective scheme has finitely many disjoint smooth integral components. Empty loci are handled vacuously. No characteristic restriction or divisibility hypothesis on the degrees is imposed.
